FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
  );

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN (
  SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_bup
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY team_api_id
) ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.avg_bup > (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bup) FROM (
    SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_bup
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
    GROUP BY team_api_id
  )
);

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN (
  SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_bup
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY team_api_id
) ta ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.avg_bup > (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bup) FROM (
    SELECT team_api_id, AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_bup
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
    GROUP BY team_api_id
  )
);
